_readme: Hand-entered zoning values for North Lebanon Township, PA. Edit this file to add districts or correct values. Never guess a value: leave it null and add a note. Set 'verified' to true only after checking against the official adopted code.
jurisdiction: North Lebanon Township, Lebanon County, PA
codeName: North Lebanon Township Code, Chapter 27 Zoning
enteredFrom: Zoneomics reproduction of the code, extract taken 2026-11-13 (groundwork/docs/reference/zoning-north-lebanon-I1.md)

districtMap.aliasNote: The 2023 zoning map labels the district 'I'; the ordinance calls it I-1.

frontSetbackFt.note: Measured from the road right-of-way. 150 ft when across the street from a residential district.

residentialSeparationFt.note: No building within 150 ft of a residentially zoned district.

maxHeightFt.note: Chimneys, towers, tanks and mechanical appurtenances up to 125 ft.

maxLotCoveragePct.note: Definition of 'lot coverage' is in 27-102 (not checked).

parkingRatios.rule: 1 space per 2 employees on the combined two largest successive shifts
